cards.title: Site-wide robotic stoppage with AGV synchronization loss
cards.user_facing_summary: Use this response pattern when operators report that robots or AGVs are stopped, nothing is moving, the small sort is not running, or the robotic system is not responding. Confirm the scope and observable system state, investigate service and application health, restore the named robotic service or gateway through an approved procedure, correct residual AGV synchronization issues, and validate API and operational recovery.

The robotic system was reported as not responding.
The small sort was not running.
Multiple bots were reported as not moving in different areas.
Totes could not be removed from the hospital workflow.
The RMS/HMI appeared mostly blank and displayed a message reported as '.NET Control not created.'
AGVs were reported as out of sync.

node_retrieval_summaries.intent: Determine whether the report represents a site-wide or broad robotic stoppage with abnormal control-system presentation rather than an isolated robot issue.

Healthy signals are localized impact with otherwise normal fleet presentation. Inconclusive signals are an unclear scope report, unreadable RMS display, or unavailable site confirmation.

node_retrieval_summaries.title: Check for a named service or application failure
node_retrieval_summaries.intent: Determine whether Windows evidence indicates an OptiSweep service termination or clustered WCSWebApplication/application errors that correlate with the broad stoppage.

Unhealthy signals are a System-log Service Control Manager event showing OptiSweep terminated unexpectedly, or Application-log WCSWebApplication/Application Error entries clustered around the reported interruption, including the visible Event ID 20102 failed database-command evidence. Inconclusive signals are unavailable logs, ambiguous timestamps, or errors without a credible temporal relationship to the stoppage.

node_retrieval_summaries.intent: Confirm that the recovered control path responds before attempting residual AGV correction or releasing the site to automated operation.

Unhealthy signals are no API response, unavailable gateway, or a stopped or repeatedly failing service. Inconclusive signals are HTTP success with unclear data validity, such as the observed schema warning, or a status page without confirmation of current service responsiveness.

cards.user_facing_summary: Use this path when a site reports that an ACB or zone cannot obtain an AMR pair, multiple AMRs route unexpectedly, or the system appears down after an AMR replacement or add/remove event.

The ACB system is described as down or production is seriously impacted.
Replacement AMRs reportedly route to the hospital lane instead of supporting the affected workflow.
An AMR was previously reported with low battery or in an abnormal physical location.
